function: Learns IRS phase shift jointly with UAV trajectory (Double DQN or DDPG) to maximize downlink energy efficiency; power allocation is convex optimization, not learned (pp. 5-6).
system: Single-antenna UAV and 5 or 10 UEs; reflecting IRS on a skyscraper, ULA of M elements, continuous phases; Rician links; frequency band not stated (pp. 3-4, 8).
method: DDPG (CV-PG) and Double DQN (CV-Double DQN), reinforcement learning, alternate with convex-optimization power allocation in an iterative loop; trained 1200 iterations (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician LoS plus Rayleigh NLoS links, path-loss exponents 2.5 (UAV-UE) and 2.2 (IRS-UE), Rician factor 10 dB; no dataset, agent learns by interaction (pp. 4, 8).
test_conditions: Same simulated 100x100 m area with Keep-out-Zone for training and results; sweeps over UEs (2-10), power, reflecting units, area; no unseen-scenario test reported (pp. 7-11).
baselines: Non-learned: exhaustive search, full random search, fixed phase shifts; learned: CV-DQN, CV-Dueling DQN, CV-Double DQN; DRL without IRS (pp. 8-10).
metrics: Energy efficiency in bit/J (sum rate over UAV transmit power) versus iterations, UEs, maximum power, reflecting units and area; UAV trajectories (pp. 4, 8-11).
complexity: Order O(K + M + sum of n(l-1)n(l)): O(K) convex power allocation, O(M) IRS phase, fully connected networks with L layers (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 4: "kd and kr represent the Rician factors"; p. 4: "random Rayleigh distribution NLoS components"
q2_support: p. 11: "Fig. 12 indicates the EE of different algorithms and regions"
q3_support: p. 8: "The optimal value is found by completely searching"; p. 8: "are jointly solved by the full random search algorithm"; p. 8: "double DQN, CV-Dueling DQN, and CV-DQN with different"
q4_support: p. 7: "the complexity to update the transmission power is O(K)"; p. 7: "the complexity for optimizing the IRS phase shift is O(M)"
q5_support: p. 7: "In this simulation, we consider a rectangular area of 100*100 square meters"
notes: Included: Double DQN and DDPG learn the IRS phase shift (physical layer) jointly with the UAV trajectory (above PHY) (p. 5, action A[n] with a_theta; Algorithms 3 and 4), so above_phy does not apply; power allocation is solved by convex optimization (p. 5) and no computation offloading is modeled (p. 12, future work). Area 6 rather than 3: the learned IRS-phase control serves a UAV (aerial) link and 6 precedes 3 in the Step 2 order; the IRS phase alone would be area 3. q1=0: custom Rician and Rayleigh model, no 3GPP or measured channel (p. 4). q2=0: sweeps over UEs, power, reflecting units and area are reported (Figs. 5-8, 11, 12), but the paper never states that a trained policy is tested on a condition unseen in training. q3=1: non-learned exhaustive and full random search, and learned DQN and Dueling DQN applied to the same problem, all compared on energy efficiency (p. 8, Figs. 5, 6, 8). q4=1: complexity order on p. 7 (no runtime or FLOPs). q5=0: simulated scenario, no code or data link. Tables I to III (p. 8) were read from the page image; the carrier frequency is not given.
